focus_area_title: Consider the Use of Educational Empowerment Programs
content_text_body:
### Why is it Important?
Educational empowerment programs are training programs in which hospital staff are provided with education regarding patient safety, patient safety culture, the importance of speaking out when observing threats to patient safety, and other skills to empower individuals to prioritize safety. These types of trainings can include the use of workshops, the distribution of posters and educational pamphlets, lectures, or group discussions.

The Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ) recommends the use of TeamSTEPPS (Team Strategies and Tools to Enhance Performance and Patient Safety), a workshop with the goal of improving patient outcomes through enhanced communication, leadership, mutual support, and situational monitoring skills. According to a study published in BMC Medical Education, TeamSTEPPS has been shown to be effective in improving safety outcomes and overall patient safety culture.

Learn more about TeamSTEPPS [here]( https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps/about-teamstepps/index.html).
